title: PPTX-Narrator: Narrated slides and videos from the notes in a PowerPoint deck, in a cloned voice and multiple languages
description: Open-source Python tool that turns the presenter notes of a PowerPoint deck into narration and embeds the audio and slide timings in the deck, which then plays by itself and can be exported as a video. The narration is synthesized with Qwen3-TTS or GPT-SoVITS in a voice cloned from a few seconds of reference speech. The note language is identified automatically and the notes can be machine-translated, so the same slides can be narrated in several languages; user-defined dictionaries fix the reading and translation of technical terms and units, and an ASR round trip flags slides whose narration deviates from the text.
